subject: Request: Threshold onboarding discount for Medivault pilot — VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Sachin Rao <sachin@medivault.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot pricing request + short term concession

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved the latency profile and tracing features. We want to run a focused pilot (3–6 months) across two treatment cohorts but our board expects lower first-quarter spend than we forecasted.

We'd like to propose a one-time onboarding concession to get the pilot started: a 30% effective discount on inference costs for the first 90 days with a modest committed credit (we can discuss level). We know this is non-standard — attaching a short pilot ask and expected usage for context.

Can you route this for fast approval? We aim to start Jan 10.

Thanks,
Sachin Rao
Head of AI Platforms — Medivault
Sachin@medivault.ai
Attachments: Medivault_Pilot_Request.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pricing request + short term concession — recommendation for vetting

Team, forwarding Medivault's pilot ask (attached). Quick summary: they want a short-term (90d) ~30% effective discount to overcome near-term budget constraints and commit to a small credit. Pilot starts Jan 10 ideally.

My recommended approach (operational & revenue rationale):
- Offer a one-time 25% discount on inference unit price for the first 60 days; require a refundable committed credit equal to 20% of expected spend over 60 days (clawback if under-usage).
- Limit to the pilot scope (2 cohorts) and instrument strict usage thresholds + telemetry gating (we can disable discount if they exceed designated accounts).
- Acceptance requires contractual guardrails: term-limited discount, commit floors, and a short reprice clause after 60 days.

Why this is conservative: 25% still gives them an incentive while protecting ARR downside and preserving precedent. I flagged potential operational risk: if we accept 30% and keep it open-ended or forget to instrument a clawback, we create a price precedent for similar health prospects in Q1.

Attachments: Medivault_MAAP_PRICING_ANALYSIS.xlsx (my model)

Can Marissa/Grace confirm from a deal-structure perspective and Markus/finance for the CFO-level signoff path? I can draft the approval memo to send to CFO this week — need decision by EOD Wed (Dec 1) to hit their Jan start.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing request + short term concession — recommendation for vetting

+1 to Priya's conservative position but a few notes from revenue ops perspective:

- Cap the one-time credit: set a hard cap at $50k total concession across the pilot. That avoids an open-ended liability.
- Replace "refundable committed credit" language with a minimum usage floor tied to invoices (clawback via credit memo if they fail to hit 60% of predicted usage).
- Require a mixed-payment schedule: 50% upfront credit, 50% invoiced; refunds handled via credit memo.
- Include an "auto-reprice" clause at day 61 to transition to standard list pricing if they exceed pilot scope.

If these are acceptable, I can prepare the finance impact note for Markus. My suggestion would be to lower the concession to 20% with the $50k cap and the usage floor — smaller headline discount but better protection.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing request + short term concession — recommendation for vetting

Thanks team — I support a constrained concession to protect both close velocity and revenue integrity. My operational ask: shorten the concession window to 45–60 days (not 90) and require a contract amendment that includes:

- Commit floors and a 30-day notice reprice trigger;
- Cap the total concession (Marissa's $50k is reasonable);
- Tie metric gating to product flags so we can quickly cutoff discount if abuse occurs.

Markus — please confirm the CFO path for a one-off concession like this. If you sign off we should send a brief memo to the CFO showing expected net present value impact and precedent mitigation steps.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: CFO signoff request: Medivault onboarding concession (deadline EOD Wed)

Markus — routing the assembled recommendation for CFO signoff. Summary below; full attachments are included.

Ask: CFO signoff for a one-time, limited onboarding concession to Medivault for a pilot that starts Jan 10.

Recommended term (compromise):
- Headline concession: 20% discount on inference unit price for first 60 days.
- Financial guardrails: $50,000 maximum concession cap; 20% of expected spend collected as refundable credit (applied 50% upfront / 50% invoiced); clawback if usage < 60% of forecast (credit memo).
- Operational guardrails: instrument product flags for accounts in pilot; automatic reprice at day 61; contract amendment limited to pilot cohort accounts only.
- Legal/Contract ask: short SOW addendum + reprice language.

Rationale: accelerates win velocity for a high-strategic health prospect, preserves near-term revenue (cap + clawback) and reduces precedent risk by limiting time and scope.

Decision needed by EOD Wed (Dec 1) to meet Medivault's Jan 10 start. If approved I will draft the CFO memo and route to legal for SOW addendum.

Attachments: Medivault_MAAP_PRICING_ANALYSIS.xlsx, Medivault_Pilot_Request.pdf, SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
